migration: 1.0.0 to 1.1.0: anchors made game-agnostic (constants live in the game profile), lens gates added; ids, weights and passAt unchanged; 1.1.0 to 1.1.1: gameProfile generalized to your-game-profile for the public kit and hash recomputed with the documented kit algorithm (spec/RUBRIC_HASH.md); ids, weights, anchors and passAt unchanged; 1.1.1 to 1.1.2: Public frame-budget wording now reflects the device profile. Scoring rules and pack fields are unchanged. 1.1.2 to 1.1.3: Evidence descriptions and fixture working directories now refer to the distributed kit. 1.1.3 to 1.1.4: Empty samples and zero case counts earn U. Computed lines require the declared evidence type. Seed repeatability requires two runs. The owner profile supplies the pose and slope coverage. 1.1.4 to 1.1.5: Adds per-view overlap measurements, clip and pose coverage and independently identified repeat exports. 1.1.5 to 1.2.0: Line, pillar and anchor wording made genre-neutral (ids, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged); adds owner-selected not-applicable profiles static-props. 1.2.0 to 1.3.0: Evidence pack names made genre-neutral (weaponSilhouette to attachedPropSilhouette; aim-up to reach-up; aim-down to reach-down). Scoring, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged; rename these fields in packs made for 1.2.0.
levels: Levels 0 to 4, or U. U earns zero points and excludes the line weight from measured coverage. Record skipped execution as NOT_RUN.

verdict: PASS, CONDITIONAL or BLOCKED is reported separately from the grade and coverage. An unresolved P0 blocks.
source: Gameplay-camera captures, collider overlays, art references and render measurements for the target build.
samplePolicy: Each computed metric group needs a nonempty population. Use the listed sample arrays or positive integer case counts. For other groups supply a positive integer measuredCases from the capture. Empty inputs or zero measured cases earn U and zero points. A measured zero failures is valid.

static-props.reason: Props are never held, attached or animated through extreme poses. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.
